widget.name: Truck Scheduler Vertical
widget.description: Vertical-axis truck scheduling grid. Bays appear as columns across the top; time runs downward in 5-minute increments. Supports drag/move/resize, Plan vs Actual split bands, and conflict highlighting.

property.caption: Schedule Data
property.description: List of schedule objects — one per truck-bay assignment.

property.caption: Truck ID
property.description: String attribute identifying the truck (e.g. "TRK-0042").

property.caption: Bay ID
property.description: String attribute identifying the loading bay (e.g. "A1", "North-12"). Bay columns are derived dynamically.

property.caption: Start Time
property.description: DateTime attribute for when the truck arrives at the bay.

property.caption: End Time
property.description: DateTime attribute for when the truck departs the bay.

property.caption: Status
property.description: Optional status attribute — Scheduled / InProgress / Completed / Conflict.

property.caption: Color Override
property.description: Optional CSS hex color per truck block (e.g. "#E57373"). Overrides status-based coloring.

property.caption: Tooltip Line 1
property.description: First custom line shown inside the block (and in the hover tooltip).

property.caption: Tooltip Line 2
property.description: Second custom line in the hover tooltip.

property.caption: Plan / Actual
property.description: Optional attribute that splits each bay column into Plan (left) and Actual (right) sub-columns. Values containing "actual" (case-insensitive) go to the Actual sub-column; all other values go to Plan.

property.caption: Display Date
property.description: DateTime attribute controlling which day's schedule is shown. Defaults to today when empty.

property.caption: Actual Schedule Data
property.description: Optional separate list of actual schedule entries. When configured, all Schedule Data entries are treated as Plan and these entries as Actual — the Plan/Actual attribute is ignored.

property.caption: Truck ID
property.description: String attribute identifying the truck in the actual entry.

property.caption: Bay ID
property.description: String attribute identifying the bay in the actual entry.

property.caption: Start Time
property.description: DateTime of actual truck arrival.

property.caption: End Time
property.description: DateTime of actual truck departure.

property.caption: Status
property.description: Optional status of the actual entry.

property.caption: Color Override
property.description: Optional CSS hex color for actual blocks.

property.caption: Tooltip Line 1
property.description: First tooltip line shown on actual truck blocks.

property.caption: Tooltip Line 2
property.description: Second tooltip line shown on actual truck blocks.

property.caption: On Actual Truck Click
property.description: Action triggered when an actual truck block is clicked. The context object comes from Actual Schedule Data.

property.caption: Bay Status Data
property.description: Separate list of bay objects — one row per bay. Provides the status indicator color and truck occupancy icon in bay column headers.

property.caption: Bay ID
property.description: Attribute identifying the bay — must match the Bay ID values in Schedule Data.

property.caption: Color
property.description: Bay status color for the indicator. Accepted values: "available"/"green" → green, "occupied"/"blue" → blue, "maintenance"/"red" → red, or any CSS hex color (#rrggbb).

property.caption: Occupancy
property.description: Controls the truck icon: "occupied"/"yes"/"true" → filled truck; "available"/"no"/"false" → outlined truck.

property.caption: Sort Order
property.description: Numeric attribute defining column display order — lower numbers appear first.

property.caption: Bay Type
property.description: Optional label shown below the bay name in the column header (e.g. "Inbound", "Outbound", "Cold").

property.caption: On Truck Block Click
property.description: Action triggered when an existing truck block is clicked.

property.caption: On Schedule Change (drag / resize)
property.description: Action called after a block is moved or resized. window.__TruckSchedulerPendingEdit is populated with {newStartISO, newEndISO, newBayId} before firing.

property.caption: On Empty Slot Click
property.description: Action triggered when the user clicks an empty bay-time slot. window.__TruckSchedulerNewSlot is set to {bayId, startISO, endISO} before firing.

property.caption: On Bay Header Click
property.description: Action triggered when the user clicks a bay column header (bay name or truck icon). window.__TruckSchedulerBayClick is set to {bayId} before firing.

property.caption: Slot Height (px)
property.description: Pixel height of each 5-minute time slot in the grid. Default 18. Increase for larger touch targets.

property.caption: Column Width (px)
property.description: Fixed pixel width for each bay column. Set to 0 (default) to auto-fit all visible bay columns to the widget width.

property.caption: Time Column Label
property.description: Header text for the left-hand time column — e.g. "Time", "Schedule".

property.caption: Bays Per Page
property.description: Maximum number of bay columns visible at once. Navigation arrows page through the rest. Set to 0 to show all bays.

property.caption: Time Range Start (hour 0-23)
property.description: First hour shown on timeline. 0 = midnight. Overridden by Time Range Start Variable if set.

property.caption: Time Range End (hour 1-24)
property.description: Last hour shown on timeline. 24 = midnight. Overridden by Time Range End Variable if set.

property.caption: Time Range Start (variable)
property.description: Page integer variable that dynamically overrides the static Time Range Start setting.

property.caption: Time Range End (variable)
property.description: Page integer variable that dynamically overrides the static Time Range End setting.

property.caption: Sort Bays by Start Time
property.description: When enabled, bays are ordered by their earliest truck arrival on the displayed day. Disable to use the natural bay name order.

property.caption: Show 25-Minute Dwell Markers
property.description: When enabled, faint horizontal lines appear every 25 minutes to help with visual slot estimation.

property.caption: Default Dwell Duration (minutes)
property.description: Duration used for new truck blocks created by clicking an empty slot. Default 25 minutes.

property.caption: Show Actual Sub-Column
property.description: When enabled and Plan/Actual attribute is configured, each bay column shows a Plan sub-column and an Actual sub-column side by side. Disable to show only Plan. Can be overridden at runtime via Show Actual Rows Variable.

property.caption: Show Actual Sub-Column (variable)
property.description: Boolean page variable that dynamically overrides the Show Actual Sub-Column setting.

property.caption: Color: Scheduled
property.description: Block fill color for "Scheduled" status.

property.caption: Color: In Progress / Completed
property.description: Block fill color for "InProgress" and "Completed" statuses.

property.caption: Color: Delayed
property.description: Block fill color for "Delayed" status.

property.caption: Color: Conflict
property.description: Block fill color when two trucks overlap the same bay at the same time.

property.caption: Time Window Opacity
property.description: Overall opacity applied to all time window bands. 0.0 = invisible, 1.0 = fully opaque. Default 0.55. Per-band alpha can also be embedded in the color using 8-digit hex (#rrggbbaa) or rgba() — both multiply together.

property.caption: Time Windows
property.description: Comma-separated time bands with background tints. Format: "startH-endH:color". Hours 0-24. Color: 6-digit hex (#rrggbb), 8-digit hex with alpha (#rrggbbaa), or rgba(r,g,b,a). Overall opacity is controlled by the Time Window Opacity field above.

property.caption: Default Bay Group
property.description: Bay group shown on first load (e.g. "AR"). Overridden by Default Bay Group Variable when bound. Leave empty to start in all-bays paginated view.

property.caption: Default Bay Group (Variable)
property.description: Bind to a page string attribute or variable to control the active group externally. Changing the bound value (e.g. from a microflow) immediately switches the visible group. Selecting a group in the toolbar writes the value back if the attribute is editable.
